entities.name: Segante Guarneri
entities.description: An aspiring necromantic wizard and essence-studies student from Fiora, invited to the first multiplanar class at Strixhaven; identified as an ember.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: Segante's home plane, ruled by the queen Marchesa.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios that admitted the first official multiplanar class.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven University stands.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The college of growth and decay at Strixhaven, which Segante aspires to join.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The queen of Fiora and Segante's aunt, whose man poisoned Segante's mother.

entities.name: Professor Kasmina
entities.description: A professor who recruited the five multiplanar students, planning to force them to ignite and rob their sparks; she presumably died in the final confrontation.

entities.name: Eula Blue
entities.description: A classmate of Segante who longed to share his secrets and became his intimate partner.

entities.name: Alandra
entities.description: A member of Segante's multiplanar class.

entities.name: Jamira
entities.description: A member of Segante's multiplanar class.

entities.name: Kequia Akosa
entities.description: A member of Segante's multiplanar class.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: The professor charged with punishing the five students after Kasmina's plot.

entities.name: Arcavios Preservation Society
entities.description: A group that targeted the multiplanar students; Segante saved Eula from it.

events.summary: Segante's mother died of poisoning by one of Marchesa's men after years confined to a single house.
events.quote: This lasted until she his mother died of poisoning by one of Marchesa's men.

events.summary: Kasmina recruited Segante for Strixhaven as an ember and powerful wizard, and his father agreed.
events.quote: Segante was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina

events.summary: Segante formed a class with Eula, Alandra, Jamira and Kequia Akosa on Arcavios.
events.quote: On Arcavios, Segante formed a class with Eula Blue

events.summary: Segante bonded with Eula only after offering to pay her for doing his laundry.
events.quote: He could only bond with Eula after he offered to pay her for doing his laundry.

events.summary: After Segante saved Eula from the Arcavios Preservation Society, they began an intimate relationship.
events.quote: after saving Eula from the Arcavios Preservation Society they began an intimate relationship

events.summary: Kasmina's secret plot to force the students to ignite and rob their sparks was thwarted when the five combined their powers; she presumably died in the snarl.
events.quote: This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers

events.summary: Professor Vess let the students stay and pledge to colleges, but forbade them from relocating to the colleges' dorms.
events.quote: She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges

relations.note: Kasmina plotted to rob the students' sparks.
relations.quote: to rob their sparks to reignite her own
